title: Japanese Crispy Duck Leg
description: A crispy Japanese inspired dish made with pan-seared duck leg and a crunchy topping.
instructions: 1. Rinse the duck leg and pat it dry.
2. Season the duck leg with salt and pepper.
3. Mix the light breading and crumble in a shallow dish.
4. Dip the duck leg in the breading mixture, coating it evenly.
5. Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
6. Sear the duck leg for 5 minutes on each side, until crispy.
7. Transfer the duck leg to the oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, until cooked through.
8. Meanwhile, heat the bitter Chinese sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
9. Brush the sauce over the duck leg during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
10. Let the duck leg rest for 5 minutes before serving.
